codeQuality.basis: Method Complexity of selected production implementations. Decomposition, duplication and coverage/CRAP are unscored review evidence.

duplication.scope: Exact whole-function AST bodies; names/literals retained; signatures, decorators, leading docstrings and locations excluded. Populations and async/sync kinds compared separately. Not semantic equivalence, partial-block detection, a duplication percentage, or a score.

coverageReview.scope: Line-coverage CRAP review estimates, not scores or defect predictions. Imports without collection provenance have unverified source binding and freshness. New review IDs never authenticate historical coverage. Line coverage is not basis-path coverage or test effectiveness.

decomposition.scope: Owned AST statements and block nesting, separately measured. Nested definitions and declaration syntax excluded. Lambdas unavailable. No expression-size measurement, score, threshold, or safe-extraction claim.

scope.description: Selected Python implementation bodies. File roles are explicit scope conventions, not runtime reachability or defect judgments. See selection inventory.

codeQuality.populationNotes: Units are observed Python files; members are selected implementation bodies. Types are not measured (the required types field is a placeholder zero). Pruned directories do not enumerate unseen files.

scoring.contributionMode: aggregate; findings are not independent deductions
